set.body:
Six defects, all reproduced at HEAD, all with runnable code in board post post-01KZYYBQY1ECM7FVSQW9SVC7W0.

WHY FIRST: these are wrong answers or corrupted objects, not friction. Two of them (cross_partitions on a fit, regions with NA labels) return well-formed objects containing nonsense, which is the worst failure mode in a package whose entire argument is that identity cannot be inferred from shape.

ORDER WITHIN: fix bd-01KZYJAQ7Y06F5C1P7KG6MAJE4 BEFORE the message work in Epic R3. It is the exemplar message that R3 proposes copying forty times, and following its advice currently fails twice.

ACCEPTANCE: the reproduction script runs clean at HEAD; each bug gets a regression test; the two silent-wrong-result bugs get tests asserting the refusal or the warning, not just the corrected value.
